description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_StringHashParser for parsing string hash configuration files, including methods for parsing single and multiple hash files, with internal handling of file streams.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_StringHashParser
classes.description: A class for parsing string hash files used for configuration schemas, capable of handling single and multi-hash files.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a file containing a single string-hash and returns an associative array.

methods.name: parseMultiFile
methods.description: Parses a file containing multiple string-hashes delimited by '----' and returns an array of associative arrays.

methods.name: parseHandle
methods.description: Internal method that processes a file handle to extract a string-hash into an associative array.
